#!/bin/sh
set -u

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ -z "$1" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "Usage: $0 DESTINATION" >&2
    exit 2
fi

script_dir=$(dirname "$0") || exit 1
base=$(CDPATH= cd -P "$script_dir/.." && pwd) || {
    printf '%s\n' "Cannot locate the report bundle" >&2
    exit 1
}

destination=$1
case $destination in
    /*) ;;
    *) destination=./$destination ;;
esac

if ! mkdir -p "$destination"; then
    printf '%s\n' "Cannot create destination: $1" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for file in summary.txt detail.txt; do
    if ! cp "$base/templates/$file" "$destination/$file"; then
        printf '%s\n' "Cannot install $file in destination: $1" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done

if ! cp "$base/launcher" "$destination/run-report"; then
    printf '%s\n' "Cannot install launcher in destination: $1" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if ! chmod 0755 "$destination/run-report"; then
    printf '%s\n' "Cannot make launcher executable in destination: $1" >&2
    exit 1
fi
ANTRIEB_INSTALLER_EOF
chmod 0755 bin/install-report && /bin/sh -n bin/install-report && sed -n '1,240p' bin/install-report
